Every major currency collapse follows the same pattern.
Weimar Germany. Argentina. Greece. Venezuela. Different eras, same outcome: savings wiped out, bank accounts frozen, paper wealth destroyed.

But some people always survive.

Not by predicting the crash.
Not by timing markets.

You don’t need to know when the next collapse happens.

snippet.title: The Flying Tigers - America's Forgotten Heroes | Episode 1: Origins | Free Documentary History
snippet.description:
The Flying Tigers - Episode 1: Origins | History Documentary 

Watch 'The Flying Tigers - Episode 2' here: https://youtu.be/3SJ-5sEbHKk

In this episode:
Before the United States entered World War II, retired US Army aviator Claire Lee Chennault travelled to China to assess the condition of the Chinese Air Force as it struggled against the Japanese invasion. What was meant to be a short assignment soon became a years-long commitment that would change the course of the air war in Asia.

Working closely with the Chinese government, Chennault helped create the American Volunteer Group — a unit of US pilots that would become legendary as the Flying Tigers. Flying shark-faced fighter planes against overwhelming odds, the group earned a reputation as one of the most famous air squadrons of the Second World War.

This episode traces the origins of the Flying Tigers and the remarkable story of the man who built them.

The series:
During World War II, a legendary group of American fighter pilots became famous for defending China against Japanese air attacks. Known as the Flying Tigers, these US airmen operated from bases in western China and played a crucial role in the early air war in the Pacific.

Formed before the United States officially entered the war, the Flying Tigers fought against overwhelming odds and quickly earned a reputation for their daring tactics and fierce resistance. Some historians believe their growing presence in the Far East increased tensions with Japan and contributed to the chain of events that ultimately led to the attack on Attack on Pearl Harbor.

From December 1941 to June 1942, the Flying Tigers provided vital aerial defence for China during one of the darkest periods of the war. Their story is one of courage, sacrifice, and innovation — yet much of it has remained untold. Until now.

snippet.title: Inside the CIA's Insane Plot to Assassinate Fidel Castro | CIA Declassified | FD History
snippet.description:
CIA Declassified - Episode 3: Castro and the Cold Cream | History Documentary

Watch the next 'CIA Declassified' episode here: https://youtu.be/oi0Q8yYY7vA

In this episode: The bizarre true story of the CIA's most intimate and dramatic plot to assassinate Cuban leader Fidel Castro: In 1959, the Agency recruited Castro's 19-year-old German-American lover, Marita Lorenz, to be their assassin. Given untraceable poison pills—allegedly sourced through the Mafia—Marita was tasked with bypassing Castro's elite security by slipping the toxin into his drink. We see how the fear of communism turned an affair into a high-stakes intelligence operation involving Watergate burglars, organized crime, and a deep sense of betrayal. 

The Series: These are the inside stories of America's most top secret covert operations. They involve assassins, deep undercover agents and the CIA's ultra-secret special black ops division. Each film is based upon the CIA's own documents and insider accounts from agents who were there. They show how America's spymasters tracked down and eliminated their nation's enemies.

snippet.title: Daily Life For Regular People at the Peak of the Roman Empire | Calm History Story for Sleep
snippet.description:
Experience a full day in ancient Rome as an ordinary person during the empire's golden age. This 3+ hour sleep story takes you through the streets, markets, baths, and homes of regular Romans in the 2nd century CE, when the empire was at its peak under emperors like Trajan and Hadrian.

You'll wake in a crowded insula apartment, fetch water from public fountains, work in the bustling city, visit the Roman baths, and experience the economic realities of life for plebeians and working-class citizens. This isn't the Rome of emperors and gladiators, it's the Rome of everyday survival, small joys, and human resilience.

Perfect for sleep, relaxation, study, or anyone fascinated by ancient history told in a calm, atmospheric way.

🏛️ What You'll Experience:
- Morning routines in ancient Roman apartment buildings
- The reality of Roman food, water systems, and sanitation  
- A detailed visit to Roman public baths (thermae)
- Work, trade, and the economy from the bottom up
- Religion, health, and medicine in ancient Rome
- The social hierarchy and patron-client relationships
- Evening meals and family life in the empire

All content is historically researched and presented in a soothing, ASMR-friendly narration style designed to help you fall asleep while learning about one of history's greatest civilizations.

If this helps you sleep or relax, please like and subscribe for more historical bedtime stories. Let me know in the comments where you're listening from and what historical period you'd like to explore next.

Sweet dreams from the Eternal City. 🌙

snippet.title: King Arthur: Why the Tale of Britain's Legendary King is Still Alive Today | FD History
snippet.description:
King Arthur: The Legend | History Documentary

Watch 'The Witch Hunt King: How James I. Unleashed a Century of Terror' here: https://youtu.be/nz0l4O6NxV8

The enduring myth of King Arthur has captivated hearts and minds for over a thousand years. But where did it all begin—and why does it still resonate today?
This visually stunning documentary traces the evolution of the King Arthur legend, from its mystical Celtic roots to its global fame in books, film, and pop culture. snippet.title: How Cutting Russia From SWIFT Destroyed the Dollar Forever
snippet.description:
In February 2022, the United States and the European Union launched what many analysts called the most powerful financial strike in modern history: Russia was disconnected from SWIFT, and nearly $300 billion of its foreign reserves were frozen overnight.
For decades, the global economy assumed that any nation cut off from the dollar system would collapse.

But something unexpected happened.
Russia didn’t implode — the global monetary order did.

Two years later, Russia rebuilt trade routes, stabilized the ruble, and expanded partnerships across Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Meanwhile, dozens of countries began preparing for a world where the dollar is no longer the unquestioned financial center of gravity.

This shift is not random. It follows a pattern seen multiple times over the last century:
A dominant power weaponizes its currency… and unintentionally accelerates its own decline.

In this video, we uncover the deeper forces reshaping global finance right now:

• How dollar dominance eroded from 71% of global reserves to 58%
• Why China’s CIPS network exploded in size, processing trillions in alternative settlements
• How Russia rewired its trade system in record time using non-dollar currencies
• Why Saudi Arabia’s willingness to accept yuan for oil is a geopolitical earthquake
• The silent gold accumulation by central banks — the largest since the 1970s

The SWIFT cutoff proved something no nation ever wanted to admit:
you can survive outside the dollar system — and even thrive.

For the first time since 1945, the world is moving toward a multipolar currency structure, where the dollar remains important but no longer untouchable.
America hasn’t lost a war — it’s losing its greatest advantage: the ability to control the global financial system.

This is not the end of the dollar…
but it is the end of dollar supremacy.

snippet.title: THESE JOBS WILL DISAPPEAR FIRST!
snippet.description:
Mo Gawdat believes up to 30% of jobs in certain sectors could disappear by 2028.

That stopped me in my tracks.

Mo was one of the first people to come on this podcast and warn me about AI, long before most of the world was talking about it.

At the time, it felt early.

Now, it feels like the world is catching up to what he was seeing.

I’m still trying to understand what AI actually means for our lives.

Not just whether it can write emails, create images or make us more productive. I mean what it does to jobs. What it does to power. What it does to education. What it does to human connection…

That’s why I wanted to have this discussion with Mo again.

What makes Mo worth listening to is that he saw these systems inside Google years before most of us had even heard the term AI. His book *Scary Smart* now feels like it was written for this exact moment.

Let me explain why this discussion matters.

Mo believes we’re not just entering an AI revolution. We’re entering a period where AI, robotics, economics, surveillance, digital currencies and global instability are all colliding at the same time.

That’s a lot for any of us to process.

We spoke about:

- The jobs Mo believes are most at risk from AI.
- Why he believes that AI is actually underhyped!
- The mistake almost everyone is making with ChatGPT.
- The prediction that changed even his own view of the future.

The part that stayed with me was this idea that human connection may become the real currency.

Because if AI can produce the information, write the report, analyse the data, then what is left?

I don’t think this conversation gives neat answers. That’s probably why it’s worth watching.

It helped me think more honestly about what’s coming.

snippet.title: Germany’s $500 Billion Mistake: The Green Energy Trap
snippet.description:
Germany spent over $500 billion chasing the dream of green energy leadership. What they got instead were the highest electricity prices in Europe, a collapsing industrial base, and a power grid increasingly dependent on coal just to survive.
